_doc: Translator context (D1). Each English key gets the note of its longest matching prefix (or an exact key entry). Placeholder notes are appended automatically. Brand words ({{@chaupaal}}, {{@dangal}} …) are never translated. Tone everywhere: warm, plain, short; second person; no slang.

Shared app chrome: buttons, labels, short status lines reused across screens. Keep short — they sit in buttons and chips (≈ +40% length max).
prefixes.common.og_: Link-preview cards (WhatsApp / social unfurls) for shared profiles, posts, stories and invites. Plain text, one line.
prefixes.common.search_: Subtitle under a search result row.
Sign-up, log-in, password reset and phone verification screens. Clear and reassuring; errors give one next step.
First-run screens and the plain-language 'What Chaupaal collects' list.
The user's profile: editing fields, profile sections, digital layout blocks, prompts and visibility.
Settings screens (toggles and their one-line descriptions).
Privacy & data: consent banner, Teen mode, age question, data export / deletion, parental consent. Calm and precise; never alarming.
DRAFT legal pages (Terms, Privacy, Guidelines, Teens, Service providers, Contact). Keep [bracketed placeholders] exactly; translate literally, do not add or drop obligations.
Reporting, decisions ('statement of reasons') and appeals. Neutral, factual; reasons are category names.
Baithak = the chats tab (1:1 and groups).
Inside a chat: message bubbles, attachments, system lines ('X added Y').
Mehfil = live voice / video rooms inside a chat.
Music search, previews and shared songs.
Photo / video / GIF pickers and upload states.
Duniya = the photo / post feed and stories.
Akhbaar = the daily news quiz + news categories.
Peepal = community questions and people discovery.
People discovery: search chips, match reasons, refine options.
Membership tiers (Pradhan, Sarpanch) and Chaupaal Money. Prices are inserted as {{price}}.
The 'Translate' link on user posts / messages and its consent sheet.
Error toasts. One clear sentence + next step; no technical words.
Notification inbox lines. {{actor}} is a person's name; keep it at the start where natural.
Push notification body (lock screen). Max ~100 characters.
Proactive cards from Chaupaal (journal prompt, wishes, check-ins, weekly picks, local prompts). Gentle, optional, never guilt-tripping; always clearly from the app.
Day-1–7 reminder notifications. Honest, never fake social proof.
Dangal = the games hub (Manch library, matchmaking, chips, ratings).
Party Hub: in-person party games on one or several phones.
Classic board / card games (Ludo, Carrom, Rummy …).
Solo games (Tip Tap, Brick Breaker, Kakuro, Shabd Five).
Country names for player flags — use the standard name in the target language.
In-game text for one game: rules, prompts, results, bot lines. Game words (moves, roles) follow the game's usual terms in the target language.
Chess: use standard chess terminology of the target language (check, mate, castling, openings).
Street cricket: use the common cricket terms of the target language; commentary is lively but short.
Tambola (housie/bingo): number calls; keep traditional calls short.
Poker with virtual chips only (no real money) — never imply cash.
Teen Patti with virtual chips only (no real money) — never imply cash.

params.name: a person's display name
params.actor: the person who did the action (display name)
params.date: a formatted date in the reader's locale
